# Devendra-Chaudhari
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Devendra Chaudhari | Portfolio</title>
  <style>
    :root{
      --bg: #0b1020;
      --bg-soft: #121a2d;
      --card: #17233f;
      --primary: #79d7ff;
      --primary-2: #7ef0c8;
      --text: #edf3ff;
      --muted: #b9c6dd;
      --accent: #ffb86c;
      --shadow: rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    body {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #08101d 0%, #101d35 50%, #0d1730 100%);
      color: var(--text);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }

    .container {
      width: min(1100px, 90%);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .section {
      padding: 90px 0;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: 2.1rem;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      position: relative;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .section-title::after {
      content: "";
      display: block;
      width: 70%;
      height: 4px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-2));
      border-radius: 10px;
      margin-top: 10px;
    }

    .topbar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: rgba(11, 16, 32, 0.8);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    }

    .nav {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 18px 0;
    }

    .brand {
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 22px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.96rem;
      transition: 0.2s;
    }

    .nav-links a:hover {
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    .hero {
      padding: 100px 0 80px;
    }

    .hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.3fr 0.7fr;
      gap: 35px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
      line-height: 1.1;
      margin: 0 0 16px;
    }

    .highlight {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-2));
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }

    .hero p {
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: 26px;
      max-width: 620px;
    }

    .buttons {
      display: flex;
      gap: 14px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: 16px;
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    }

    .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }

    .btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-2));
      color: #07111d;
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
      color: var(--text);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
    }

    .profile-card {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(32, 48, 79, 0.95), rgba(19, 30, 48, 0.95));
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      border-radius: 24px;
      padding: 28px;
      box-shadow: 0 25px 60px var(--shadow);
    }

    .avatar {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-2));
      border-radius: 50%;
      width: 170px;
      height: 170px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      margin: 0 auto 18px;
      font-size: 3rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #07111d;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(121, 215, 255, 0.25);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 4px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
    }

    .avatar img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center top;
      display: block;
    }

    .profile-card h3 {
      text-align: center;
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
    }

    .profile-card p {
      text-align: center;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.96rem;
    }

    .about-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 32px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .about-box, .skill-card, .project-card, .timeline-item, .edu-card, .contact-card {
      background: rgba(23, 35, 63, 0.82);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      border-radius: 18px;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(0,0,0,0.18);
    }

    .about-box {
      padding: 28px;
    }

    .about-box p {
      color: var(--muted);
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
    }

    .info-list {
      list-style: none;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .info-list li {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
      color: var(--muted);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    }

    .info-list b {
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .skills-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 22px;
    }

    .skill-card {
      padding: 28px 22px;
    }

    .skill-icon {
      font-size: 2.1rem;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .skill-card h3 {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      margin: 0 0 10px;
    }

    .skill-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.97rem;
    }

    .projects-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 22px;
    }

    .project-card {
      padding: 24px 20px;
    }

    .tag {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 7px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(121, 215, 255, 0.12);
      color: var(--primary);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .project-card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }

    .project-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .achievements-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .timeline-item {
      padding: 24px 22px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 170px 1fr;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .timeline-year {
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--accent);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .timeline-item h4 {
      margin: 0 0 6px;
      font-size: 1.15rem;
    }

    .timeline-item p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .education-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 22px;
    }

    .edu-card {
      padding: 24px 22px;
    }

    .edu-card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 6px;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }

    .edu-card h4 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--primary);
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .edu-card ul {
      margin: 12px 0 0 18px;
      color: var(--muted);
      padding: 0;
    }

    .contact-wrap {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .contact-card {
      padding: 24px 22px;
    }

    .contact-card h3 {
      margin-top: 0;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      font-size: 1.3rem;
    }

    .contact-card p, .contact-card a {
      color: var(--muted);
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      display: block;
    }

    .contact-card a:hover { color: var(--primary); }

    .inquiry-form {
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 14px;
    }

    .inquiry-form input, .inquiry-form textarea {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: inherit;
    }

    .inquiry-form input:focus, .inquiry-form textarea:focus {
      outline: none;
      border-color: var(--primary);
    }

    footer {
      padding: 20px 0 50px;
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--muted);
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .hero-content, .about-grid, .education-grid, .contact-wrap {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .skills-grid, .projects-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 620px) {
      .nav {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 14px;
      }

      .skills-grid, .projects-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .timeline-item {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <header class="topbar">
    <div class="container nav">
      <div class="brand">Devendra Chaudhari</div>
      <nav class="nav-links">
        <a href="#home">Home</a>
        <a href="#about">About</a>
        <a href="#skills">Skills</a>
        <a href="#projects">Projects</a>
        <a href="#achievements">Achievements</a>
        <a href="#education">Education</a>
        <a href="#contact">Contact</a>
        <a href="#inquiry">Inquiry</a>
      </nav>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main>
    <section id="home" class="hero">
      <div class="container hero-content">
        <div>
          <h1>Hello, I'm <span class="highlight">Devendra Chaudhari</span></h1>
          <p>
            B.Sc. CS (AIML) graduate with a strong interest in Artificial Intelligence,
            Machine Learning, and software development. I am currently pursuing M.C.S. in AIDS
            and building practical, user-focused technology solutions.
          </p>
          <div class="buttons">
            <a class="btn btn-primary" href="#projects">View Projects</a>
            <a class="btn btn-secondary" href="#contact">Contact Me</a>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="profile-card">
          <div class="avatar"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Devendra Chaudhari profile photo" /></div>
          <h3>Devendra Chaudhari</h3>
          <p>Python Developer • AI/ML Enthusiast • Problem Solver</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="about" class="section">
      <div class="container">
        <h2 class="section-title">About Me</h2>
        <div class="about-grid">
          <div class="about-box">
            <p>
              I am a Computer Science graduate with a specialization in AIML and VR,
              currently pursuing a Master of Computer Science in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science.
              I enjoy designing efficient digital solutions, solving real-world problems
              through code, and continuously improving my technical skills.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div class="about-box">
            <ul class="info-list">
              <li><b>Qualification</b> <span>B.Sc. CS (AIML)</span></li>
              <li><b>Current Study</b> <span>M.C.S. AIDS</span></li>
              <li><b>Focus</b> <span>Python, AI/ML, Web Development</span></li>
              <li><b>Email</b> <span>devendrachaudhari11.dc@gmail.com</span></li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="skills" class="section">
      <div class="container">
        <h2 class="section-title">Skills</h2>

        <div class="skills-grid">
          <div class="skill-card">
            <div class="skill-icon">🐍</div>
            <h3>Python</h3>
            <p>
              Strong foundation in Python programming, scripting, automation,
              and problem-solving for real-world applications.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div class="skill-card">
            <div class="skill-icon">📊</div>
            <h3>Data Structures & Algorithms</h3>
            <p>
              Focused on logical problem-solving, efficient coding, and algorithmic thinking.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div class="skill-card">
            <div class="skill-icon">🤖</div>
            <h3>AI / Machine Learning</h3>
            <p>
              Interested in model building, data-driven insights, and intelligent systems
              with practical use cases.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="projects" class="section">
      <div class="container">
        <h2 class="section-title">Projects</h2>

        <div class="projects-grid">
          <div class="project-card">
            <span class="tag">Python Project 1</span>
            <h3>AI Student Support Chatbot</h3>
            <p>
              Developed a Python-based interactive chatbot that helps students with
              basic academic queries, availability of resources, and guidance.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div class="project-card">
            <span class="tag">Python Project 2</span>
            <h3>Smart Attendance Management System</h3>
            <p>
              Built a Python application to manage student attendance records,
              streamline tracking, and generate summaries for reporting.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div class="project-card">
            <span class="tag">Python Project 3</span>
            <h3>Virtual Learning Dashboard</h3>
            <p>
              Created a learning-oriented application with interactive dashboard features
              to present course activity, topics, and progress in a simple interface.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="achievements" class="section">
      <div class="container">
        <h2 class="section-title">Achievements</h2>

        <div class="achievements-list">
          <div class="timeline-item">
            <div class="timeline-year">2025</div>
            <div>
              <h4>Runner-up, College Hackathon</h4>
              <p>Designed and prototyped an interactive web solution within a strict 24-hour window.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="timeline-item">
            <div class="timeline-year">2025</div>
            <div>
              <h4>Workshop on Cloud Computing & Security</h4>
              <p>Explored secure coding standards, cloud deployments, and web vulnerabilities.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="timeline-item">
            <div class="timeline-year">2024</div>
            <div>
              <h4>Academic Merit Recognition</h4>
              <p>Recognized for consistent academic excellence in computer science coursework.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="education" class="section">
      <div class="container">
        <h2 class="section-title">Education</h2>

        <div class="education-grid">
          <div class="edu-card">
            <h3>B.Sc. CS (AIML & VR)</h3>
            <h4>Sandip University · 2022 – 2026</h4>
            <p>Relevant coursework: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Virtual Reality, Data Structures, and Database Management.</p>
          </div>

          <div class="edu-card">
            <h3>Higher Secondary (Science)</h3>
            <h4>KTHM College · 2020 – 2022</h4>
            <p>Focused on Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="contact" class="section">
      <div class="container">
        <h2 class="section-title">Contact</h2>

        <div class="contact-wrap">
          <div class="contact-card">
            <h3>Let's talk</h3>
            <p>Have a project in mind, an opportunity, or just want to say hi? Reach out through any of these, or send a message directly.</p>
          </div>

          <div class="contact-card">
            <h3>Connect</h3>
            <a href="mailto:devendrachaudhari11.dc@gmail.com">Email — devendrachaudhari11.dc@gmail.com</a>
            <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/devendra-chaudhari-a4973134b" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">LinkedIn — Devendra Chaudhari</a>
            <a href="https://github.com/K4ISHHH" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">GitHub — K4ISHHH</a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="inquiry" class="section">
      <div class="container">
        <h2 class="section-title">Visitor Inquiry</h2>

        <div class="contact-wrap">
          <div class="contact-card">
            <h3>Send an Inquiry</h3>
            <p>Fill out the form below with your details. This inquiry will be sent directly to Devendra Chaudhari.</p>
          </div>

          <div class="contact-card">
            <form class="inquiry-form" action="mailto:devendrachaudhari11.dc@gmail.com" method="POST" enctype="text/plain">
              <input type="text" name="Visitor_Name" placeholder="Your Full Name" required />
              <input type="text" name="Visitor_Address" placeholder="Your Address" required />
              <input type="tel" name="Visitor_Phone" placeholder="Your Phone Number" required />
              <textarea name="Inquiry_Message" rows="4" placeholder="Your Message or Inquiry" required></textarea>
              <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" style="border: none; cursor: pointer;">Send Inquiry</button>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>

  <footer>
    <div class="container">
      © 2026 Devendra Chaudhari | Portfolio
    </div>
  </footer>

</body>
</html>
